name: Hidden Gorges
description:
Fri- Sun , October 15-16, 2022

Hidden Gorges, Mt Zero

Image Credit: @Wanderstories

Leader: Wilfred Karnoll 
Rated: Hard. Creek-based off-track, rugged terrain, steep climbs.

High clearance vehicles required. Please indicate if you have this. 

Description:
This trip is  through Private property in the vicinity of Mt Zero, Taravale.
We travel to and camp at the top of Return Creek falls, where we will be checking out Narke falls on the way in.

We drive to Hell hole gorge, explore that and then drive to Button Rock which we will climb, before returning to our camp site at Return Creek. 
If we get time,  we scramble to the bottom of Return creek falls, explore before climbing back up to the campsite.
We pack up camp and return to Paluma by evening. 

All three falls/gorges are very spectacular and Button rock has been called the Mini-Ayres rock, even though much smaller.

We are calling for early nominations including indications if people have suitable 4WD's and space to take extra people. It is what will allow us to work out how many people we can say yes to on this trip. 

We will be limiting numbers as per the wishes of the property owners.

Property Access conditions include:

Proof of COVID vaccination status – double vax minimum.

Restrictions on use (commercial, social media) of photos taken on the property.

What to bring:
Your own car-camping equipment for one night incl. tents, sleeping bag, mat, cooking utensils. day packs, water and meals. Please carry water for 2 days. 

Fees: non-members $5  

We are not collecting RSVP's via form just yet - Please email us info@townsvillebushwalkingclub.com to
a) indicate your interest
b) please let us know if you have a high clearance 4wd vehicle and if you can take a few people with you.

name: Mt Storth
description:
Leader: Molly Hoey
Image credit: @wanderstories

Sun, 25th September, 2022
Mount Storth
Image @Wanderstories
Leader: Molly Hoey
Rated: Hard  

Meeting: 7:00 am. Meeting place will be emailed closer to the time. Start and end location are on private property. Participants joining will be advised the location via email.

Distance: Approximately 15 kms return

Walk Description:

Mount Storth forms part of the Bowling Green Bay Park and reaches a  height of 632 meters above sea level.  This walk begins on Private property with the initial part winding through a series of creek beds and acts as a nice warm up before the climbing begins!
We will follow the ‘Traditional route’ and reach the summit via the prominent ridge line. Lunch at the top and then descend again.
This walk requires a high level of fitness.  There is no track, the grass is very tall and the footing is loose. Those at the front of the walk often have to cut through Passion fruit vine and other shrub.

How long:
Full day walk. Estimate back at the car park around 5 pm.

Speciality equipment: A pair of secateurs will be very useful. A secateur pouch makes carrying your pair easier. 
I strongly advise gloves as this walk too. preference). You will need boots with plenty of tread for grip.

name: Mt Spec Orchids
description:
Thu, 22nd September, 2022

Mt Spec Orchids

Image @Tracy Zessin
This time of year native orchids are in flower, and golden-bower birds bowers are active. So a great
time for a rainforest walk in Mt Spec area to view orchids and a golden-bower bird bower. If we are
lucky, and very quiet and stealthy, maybe we can sight a gold-bower bird ? (very infrequent to sight
though, especially with group of people).

Leader - Keith 
Rated -  Medium. Track walking in rainforest. Moderate hill climbs. Distance about 22 km.
Meet – Paluma Dam at 0815. [ MUST get in touch with Keith via email and let him know first please] 
 
Must be over 18 years to participate
Non-members (Visitor) fee $5

The Route –
At leaders discretion on the day – aimless wandering ? Aiming for Buttercup lookout at
Mt Spec, through the old tin mining area at Gardes, towards Foxlee’s Lookout as well (we may not
go as far as the Foxlee’s Lookout, see how things go on the day).

Water – bring water for a full day walking. Refill from creeks near Gardes / DCK is available, but the
club recommends that water resupply from natural sources is suitably treated before consumption).
Insect repellent for leeches and mozzies (leeches were hungry / active on Blue Gum last Sunday).

Anticipate back at Paluma Dam around 5 pm.

So what type of native orchids might we see ? I am no expert (so should shut-up lol). But – obviously
Buttercup orchids at Buttercup Lookout (that’s an easy one lol), Rock orchids (on rocks, believe it or
not, especially at some open creeks like Crystal Creek Falls), Christmas orchid (bit too early for it to
flower though, usually see it over summer) plus a few others. A very good link to assist identification
by Jamie Oliver is published at Rainforest Biodiversity: 5 easy species Part 8 – Orchids – Paluma – our
village in the mist

To RSVP - https://forms.gle/NA2BkQctLy6G6G1H7

name: Mt Cook
description:
Cover photo @wanderstories
Sunday, 18th September 

Mt Cook Summit
Magnetic Island NP 

Leader: Ian Wallace 
Rated: Hard  - rough terrain, Steep boulder climbs. 

Meeting:  Meeting location and details will be emailed . Start time will be at 6:15 am.

Walk Description:
Beginning at the ferry terminal in Nelly Bay, we will walk up to Mount Cook, the highest mountain on Magnetic Island, and do some exploring in the area of the adjacent peaks.
After that we will walk back down, hopefully via a different route, to the Nelly Bay ferry.
At the latest, we will catch the 6:35pm ferry, hopefully earlier.
The group leader’s decision on allowing you on the walk is final. If they believe that you are unfit or unable to do a walk or be part of the group, you will need to respect that decision.

Distances and elevations:
The total distance is about 12km. We will ascend from sea level to the top of Mt Cook, at 490m, then down again to sea level. Allow for a walk time of about 10 hours.
High levels of fitness and experience are required for this hike. The track is not well-defined, there will be some rock hopping, with sections that will be steep, uneven, hot and exposed.

name: Bluegum Creek Walk
description:
Sun, 11th September, 2022 
Bluegum Creek Walk 
Paluma Range NP 
Image credit - Cherry Judge

Leader: Cherry Judge
Rated: Medium - rough terrain, steep trails. Mostly on-trail walking with some creek crossings. 

Meeting: Meeting location and time to be emailed. We will likely be starting at 6:30 am  

Walk Description:

We will walk the Bluegum Circuit in a clockwise direction, starting along the H-Track.
Along the track we will be taking a detour to visit Triple Falls. Then we continue along the track till we come to a lagoon [on Star River] and then continue along to Miner Creek Falls. From here we start our ascent out of the valley back up to Paluma Village.

What to expect:

- Steep and uneven sections with ropes in place to assist in a couple of places
-Rock hopping & Scrambling
-Downstream from the lagoon, there is no well-defined track

Crystal Creek Falls & Gold Creek Falls
Paluma Range NP 
Image credit - Cherry Judge

Leader: Cherry Judge
Rated: Medium - rough terrain,creek crossings. This would be a good walk if you are awanting an intrailk walk with the TBWC.  steep trails. Fitness level - I would consider it a moderate grade track. If you can walk up Castle hill's Dianella or Goat track and can do that for a 6 hour period - you should be right.

Meeting: Meeting location and time to be emailed. We will likely be starting at 6:30 am  

Walk Description:

𝗪𝗲 𝗯𝗲𝗴𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗮𝗹𝗸 𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗣𝗮𝗹𝘂𝗺𝗮 𝗗𝗮𝗺, making our way through the rainforest to Big Crystal Creek Falls. We’ll spend a bit of time at the falls, this will provide an opportunity for a lunch break, a chance to look around the area (there are some great photography opportunities here) and there is a nice swimming hole too.
We will then head onward and upwards along the track to Gold Creek Falls and spend some time there.
Time permitting, we will come back via Torsten's Rock garden and Wilfred's lookout.

The hike should be around 6 hours return (including breaks).
